text: dsh-enter-guard（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH 网页输入框增加回车二次确认，减少草稿未完成时误发送。它在浏览器端监听输入区键盘和编辑事件，第一次普通 Enter 会拦截发送并显示提示，再按 Enter 才交由 DSH 发送。输入其他按键、编辑草稿、失焦或点击输入区外会取消待确认状态；空草稿、命令或文件候选菜单以及组合键会保留原有处理。适合经常在网页端输入长消息的用户；无需额外配置。

dsh-enter-guard adds second-Enter confirmation to the DSH web composer. The first plain Enter is blocked with a hint; pressing Enter again sends. Other keys or leaving the composer cancel confirmation. Empty drafts and menus keep native handling. It helps avoid sending unfinished messages.
想给 DSH 网页输入框的发送操作加一道确认。
我经常误按回车发出没写完的消息，怎么避免？
让网页端第一次按 Enter 只提示确认，第二次再发送。
输入其他字符后应取消回车待确认状态。
空白草稿不要拦截回车发送行为。
打开命令或文件候选菜单时，回车仍要正常选择项目。
Can I require a second Enter before sending a draft in the web composer?
Prevent an accidental Enter from sending my unfinished DSH message.
dsh-enter-guard 的功能「双回车确认」：第一次无修饰键的 Enter 会阻止默认发送并显示提示；待确认时再次按 Enter 即放行给 DSH。 由网页输入区的键盘事件处理。
dsh-enter-guard 的功能「键入或离开时取消」：确认待定期间输入其他按键、编辑内容、开始输入法组字、移出焦点或点击输入区外，都会取消确认状态。 由网页输入区的键盘事件处理。
dsh-enter-guard 的功能「保留菜单和快捷发送」：命令或文件候选菜单打开、空草稿、Enter 长按重复以及 Ctrl/Cmd/Shift 等修饰键均不触发首次拦截。 由网页输入区的键盘事件处理。
dsh-enter-guard 使用 DSH 网页 composer 的 DOM 选择器；代码在找不到输入框时不拦截按键，因此依赖这些界面锚点。

dsh-enter-guard README · dsh-enter-guard：Double-Enter send guard for **DeepSeek Harness**. The first `Enter` only *arms* the composer — nothing is sent. The second `Enter` sends. Pressing any other key cancels.

Stops a half-written message from being sent by an accidental Enter.

[中文说明 →](README.zh.md)

dsh-enter-guard README · dsh-enter-guard：```
type message ──▶ Enter ──▶ ✗ not sent, composer outlined, "press Enter again to send"
                     │
                     ├── Enter (again) ──▶ ✓ sent
                     └── any other key ──▶ state cancelled, back to normal

dsh-enter-guard README · The gap it fills：DeepSeek Harness sends on `Enter` and has no confirmation step. Its only setting (`Settings → General → Enter behavior`) decides whether `Enter` **queues** or **steers** while the agent is busy — it does nothing about accidental sends when the agent is idle.

dsh-enter-guard README · The gap it fills：A community catalog scan (6084 DSH plugins) turns up nothing in this category. The closest neighbours only cover half the problem: `dsh-prompt-stash` stashes a draft on demand, `dsh-composer-plus` enhances the built-in queue, `dsh-sleep-send` adds scheduled sending, and the `prompt-refine` family rewrites the draft *before* sending — none of them intercept the Enter key.

dsh-enter-guard README · Behaviour：| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| First `Enter` (no modifier, not IME-composing, not key-repeat) | **blocked** — composer outlined, hint shown |
| `Enter` while armed | passes through — DSH sends natively |
| **Any** other key while armed (letters, digits, Backspace, arrows, Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Win, CapsLock) | state cancelled immediately |
| Draft changed, IME composition start, blur, click outside | state cancelled |
| `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Enter`, clicking Send | **sends immediately**, no confirmation (deliberate escape hatch) |
| `/` command menu or `@` file menu open | passes through — Enter there selects a candidate |
| Holding `Enter` down (key repeat) | ignored, never sends by itself |
| Empty draft (no text, no attachment) | not intercepted |
| 2 seconds after arming | hint fades, **state is kept** — a later `Enter` still sends |

dsh-enter-guard README · Install：Not on npm yet — install from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Liyu147/dsh-enter-guard.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-enter-guard
```

Then **restart `dsh web`** (a page refresh is not enough — the client bundle is resolved at boot).

A local checkout works the same way; point `add` at the directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-enter-guard
```

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-enter-guard
```

dsh-enter-guard README · Install：Verify it is alive — open DevTools console and run:

```js
__dshEnterGuard.instance.inspect()
// => { version, mounted: true, armed: false, hasCard: true, everBlocked: false, ... }
```

`hasCard: false` means the composer anchor was not found — see *Compatibility*.
`everBlocked` flips to `true` once the guard has actually swallowed an Enter — that is the field proving the key path works end to end.

dsh-enter-guard README · Compatibility：Anchors come from the DSH web client (`dsh-client-ui-conversation`):

| Selector | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `[data-composer-card]` | composer card (outline + hint anchor) |
| `[data-composer-input]` | editable area (focus / emptiness check) |
| `[data-trigger-menu]` | command & file candidate menu (pass-through) |
| `[data-composer-chip]` | attachment / reference chips (counts as content) |

dsh-enter-guard README · Compatibility：If a future DSH release renames these, the plugin **fails safe**: it becomes a no-op and native `Enter` behaviour is restored. It never swallows a message. A startup self-check warns in the console 5 s after boot when the anchor is missing.

Tested against DSH **0.1.5-rc.3** on Windows / Chrome.

dsh-enter-guard README · Known limitations：1. **Enter only.** The Send button and `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Enter` always send immediately — by design.
2. **Cannot stop plugins that call `submit()` directly.** Voice-input plugins that auto-send bypass the keyboard entirely.
3. **DOM-anchor dependent** (see above).
4. **Not verified on mobile virtual keyboards** — they may not emit `keydown`.
5. One composer card is assumed (the first match). Normal single-session UI is unaffected.

dsh-enter-guard README · Design note：The guard deliberately **does not clear the draft, does not call `setDraft`, does not touch the attachment pipeline**. The text simply stays in the composer and is sent later. That is why the whole feature fits in a read-only DOM listener and why it is safe to remove at any time.

dsh-enter-guard README · Testing：Two zero-dependency Node harnesses (fake DOM, no browser, no DSH involved):

```bash
node test_guard_enter_send_v1.js    # core state machine, 17 cases
node test_client_bundle_v1.js       # the packaged bundle, 12 cases
```

These live in the parent directory of this package (the development workspace), not in the published tarball.

Manual regression before trusting it — six checks:

dsh-enter-guard README · Testing：1. `/` opens the command menu → `Enter` **selects** a candidate
2. `@` opens the file menu → `Enter` **inserts** the reference
3. `Shift`+`Enter` → inserts a **newline**, no outline
4. `Ctrl`+`Enter` → **sends immediately**
5. Agent busy + `Enter` → still queues / steers as configured
6. Paste an image, then `Enter` → attachment **is sent with the message**

dsh-enter-guard README · Security：Read-only DOM. A single document-level `keydown`/`input`/`compositionstart`/`focusout`/`click` listener set, one injected `<style>`, one floating hint `<div>`.

- no `fetch`, no `XMLHttpRequest`, no `WebSocket`
- no `localStorage`, no `sessionStorage`, no cookies
- no session data, no settings writes, no host-side code (the host half is an empty shell)
- all decision code is wrapped in `try/catch` and **fails open** — an internal error restores native behaviour instead of eating the key
